WHAT: Vinted has a live image search feature (vinted.com search bar camera icon) backed by two API endpoints.

FLOW:
1. POST https://www.vinted.com/api/v2/photos
   - multipart: photo[file]=<image>, photo[type]=image_search
   - Headers: x-csrf-token (extracted from JS bundle), x-anon-id (from x-anon-id response header on catalog page)
   - Needs DataDome cookie (generated by client-side JS — blocks curl/requests)
   - Returns UUID → browser navigates to /catalog?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid>

2. GET https://www.vinted.lt/api/v2/catalog/items?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid>
   - Works cross-domain (vinted.com UUID works on vinted.lt)
   - Works with simple guest Bearer token
   - Returns same format as regular catalog search

FEATURE FLAG: image_search_upload_api_gateway — when 'on' AND logged in, uses newer POST /images/v1/images with field 'stream' and param photo_type='query_image'. Non-logged-in users use old /api/v2/photos.

BLOCKER: DataDome anti-bot blocks step 1. Valid cookies + CSRF token still get 400/500. DataDome requires JS execution to generate its cookie.

WORKAROUND OPTIONS:
- Playwright with stealth plugin (reliable but 50MB overhead)
- Proxy through user's browser (frontend opens hidden iframe, does upload, returns UUID)
- capsolver.com or similar DataDome solving service (paid)
